per_session.adapter: Explicit adapter; unknown is not Chipsoft or offline
per_session.session_id: Generated UUID-based ID (Android) or SHA-256 of generated run basename (desktop); never VIN/serial/path
per_session.attempt_id: Correlate connection attempt with emulator/startup session
per_session.last_operation: Fixed operation labels only; manual controls do not export key values
per_session.primary_reason: First terminal reason wins; subsequent cleanup cannot replace it
per_session.artifacts: State each bounded report/crash/session-end/performance/binding/startup/cleanup artifact as available, missing, invalid, unreadable or oversize
per_session.terminal_fault: Unsigned 32-bit terminal PC and at most 32 recent PCs, no registers, stack bytes or screen; terminal PC is not asserted to be original fault
per_session.cleanup: Separate child exit, forced termination, USB release and protocol cleanup. Unknown is never success

retention: Retain error-associated session before other recent sessions when an ID is known; at most 5 sessions and 20 attempts; explicitly label bounded/truncated evidence
privacy: Review and explicit send consent retained. No raw bus traffic, VIN, seed/key data, credentials or firmware uploaded. Typed artifact availability never includes local paths. Description is user-entered.
qualification: Synthetic emulator and package tests do not qualify vehicle functions or diagnose prior crashes. Intel and physical Android follow-up required.
